content:
[ROUND 1 - claude-code]

claude-opus-4-6: Read the brief and your opening. Accept all 4 locks from Joel (ONE repo Next.js, Monday SoT, 3 personas only, Presidio non-bypassable). No dissent - these are constraints, not questions.

Q2 QC GATES - proposing 6 binary gates with exact checks:

1. GATE_ROUTE_CONTRACT: npm run test:routes - tests all /v1/* routes against OpenAPI spec. PASS: 200+ tests pass. FAIL: any route returns non-spec status. Owner: tests/integration/routes.test.ts

2. GATE_MONDAY_GRAPHQL: npm run test:monday - validates 30+ column IDs against live board 8087055666. PASS: all columns exist, types match. FAIL: column missing or type mismatch. Owner: tests/integration/monday-columns.test.ts

3. GATE_PRESIDIO_LEAK: npm run test:presidio - 50 prompts (25 known + 25 adversarial) sent through Presidio, intercepted requests verified zero raw PII. PASS: all sanitized. FAIL: any raw PII reaches mock LLM. Owner: tests/security/presidio-harness.test.ts

4. GATE_UI_VISUAL: npm run test:visual - Percy/Chromatic screenshot diffs for Candidate/HQ/Field dashboards. PASS: 0 diffs > 1px threshold. FAIL: unexpected visual regression. Owner: .github/workflows/visual.yml

5. GATE_E2E_PERSONA: npm run test:e2e - Playwright flows for each persona (Candidate login→dashboard→fitness, HQ login→pipeline→analytics, Field login→assessment→PST). PASS: all 3 flows complete <30s each. FAIL: any flow fails or >30s. Owner: tests/e2e/persona-flows.spec.ts

6. GATE_BUILD_CLEAN: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck. PASS: zero errors. FAIL: any error. Owner: package.json scripts

Q3 TESTING PLAN: Unit (Jest, 80% coverage), Integration (supertest + testcontainers for DB), E2E (Playwright), Visual (Chromatic), Presidio (custom harness), Load (k6 - 100 concurrent users). Block ship: any gate FAIL + no Presidio bypass flag in prod.

Q4 APPENDIX EXPANSION: A/B/C/D/E/F each needs 50+ lines minimum. Current stubs (13-28 lines) are Wave 0 placeholders, not Wave 3 executable.

Q5 JOEL SIGNOFF CRITERIA: 'Works end to end' = GATE_E2E_PERSONA passes. 'No bugs' = all 6 gates pass. 'No weird unQCed pages' = GATE_UI_VISUAL passes + manual spot-check list in SIGNOFF-LOG.md.

Standing by for responses.
